zh.title: 華信與立榮申請停飛花蓮航線 民航局審查中
zh.summary: 華信與立榮因載客率低申請停飛花蓮航線；交通部表示民航局審查中並備妥緊急疏運。
body: 華信航空與立榮航空因花蓮航線載客量不佳，已先後向交通部民航局提出停飛申請。其中，華信航空申請停飛高雄至花蓮及台中至花蓮兩條航線，立榮航空則申請停飛台北至花蓮航線。目前民航局正對相關停飛申請進行審查。
根據民航局統計資料，自2023年至2025年間，台北至花蓮航線平均載客率僅為36%，高雄至花蓮為37%，台中至花蓮為44%，三條航線載客率均不及五成。交通部指出，即使推出優惠措施與旺季加持，花蓮航線載客率仍持續下滑。
針對業者停飛申請，交通部表示體諒航空公司營運困境，並尊重民航局基於專業與市場現實所做的判斷。交通部同時強調，維護花蓮聯外交通生命線為政府責任，若未來發生緊急狀況，將隨時啟動包含陸運、海運及空運的聯合疏運機制。

en.title: Mandarin Airlines and UNI Air Apply to Suspend Hualien Routes
en.summary: Mandarin Airlines and UNI Air applied to suspend Hualien flights; Taiwan's MOTC states CAA is reviewing requests.
body: Mandarin Airlines and UNI Air have applied to suspend domestic flight routes serving Hualien due to low passenger demand. Mandarin Airlines requested to suspend Kaohsiung-Hualien and Taichung-Hualien flights, while UNI Air applied to suspend its Taipei-Hualien route. Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration is currently reviewing the applications.

Civil Aeronautics Administration statistics show average passenger load factors from 2023 to 2025 were 36 percent for Taipei-Hualien, 37 percent for Kaohsiung-Hualien, and 44 percent for Taichung-Hualien, all remaining below 50 percent.

Taiwan's Ministry of Transportation and Communications said it respects the regulator's decision based on market conditions, adding that integrated land, sea, and air emergency transport will be activated if emergency situations arise.
